findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/review-incremental-context.ts:256-275 and packages/main/src/core/review-run.ts:649-675 — HIGH: gate-time eligibility recomputation rebuilds reviewBasis from the live findings store, including findings created after the ReviewRun envelope was assembled. After an incremental reviewer records a finding, that finding changes findingDeltas/unresolvedFindings and reviewBasisDigest, so verifyReviewRunPromptEnvelope rejects the same run during later REVIEW/quorum collection. This makes valid negative reviewer evidence self-invalidating and can remove blockers from the admissible evidence set. Freeze basis inputs at ReviewRun start (or exclude current/later run findings) and add a regression proving an incremental run remains admissible after its own finding is persisted.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 5f7ec42a83: reviewBasis finding selection is cut off at ReviewRun.startedAt and verifier replay uses the same cutoff; quorum 41/41 covers post-run finding self-contamination while preserving older open findings.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/review-run.ts:79,193-227 and packages/main/src/core/prompt-envelope.ts:391-392 — HIGH: reviewer-requested full escalation exists only as an unconnected assembler parameter. The production review_run_start schema/handler accepts no escalation reason and never forwards reviewerEscalationReason, so a reviewer who finds an incremental reviewBasis incomplete cannot mechanically obtain a new full-context run with a recorded reason. The smoke invokes assembleConditionalReviewPromptEnvelope directly and therefore does not prove the user-visible path required by Story 4. Add a reviewer-authorized CLI/handler input or command that records a nonblank reason, assembles full, and cover it end-to-end.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 5f7ec42a83: reviewerEscalationReason is exposed by review_run_start CLI schema, passed through handler and trusted assembler, bound into Prompt Envelope and signed ReviewRun, durably replay-verified, and covered by production built-CLI integration.

findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/role-prompt-modularization-and-budget-execution-plan.md:314-355,768-793 — The canonical PromptEnvelope interface and the audit-field example are stale relative to the implemented v1 contract. They omit impactPolicyVersion, eligibilityReasonCodes, changedFilesDigest, impactedFilesDigest, reviewBasisDigest, incrementalContextDigest, taskSemanticDigest, selectionReason, fullContextBytes, incrementalContextBytes, escalatedToFull, escalationReason, and budgetViolation (implemented in packages/main/src/core/prompt-contracts.ts:217-229 and assembled in prompt-envelope.ts:412-435). The text also says every review run records reviewBasisDigest/incrementalContextDigest, but those fields are conditional on a trusted prior basis and are absent for first-pass safety-full runs. Update the formal schema and audit description to distinguish always-recorded v1 fields from conditional incremental-basis fields; preserve legacy-full-context compatibility and do not imply Stories 5-7 rollout.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 5f7ec42a83: canonical decision document formal PromptEnvelope and audit examples now include implemented optional selection, size, budget, task semantic and escalation fields, and distinguish first-pass/legacy full runs without reviewBasis.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/review-run.ts:79-219 — HIGH: review_run_start exposes only storyId/agent/lane/reviewedIntentRefs and never accepts or forwards reviewerEscalationReason to assembleConditionalReviewPromptEnvelope. The required reviewer flow cannot request a new full-context run with a recorded reason when an incremental reviewBasis is incomplete. The smoke proves only the pure assembler branch, while `review_run_start --help` confirms there is no product/CLI path.
findings.resolvedReason: Duplicate of F-002; the same production reviewerEscalationReason CLI-to-signed-run fix and built-CLI regression in 5f7ec42a83 resolves it.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/impact-classification-policy.ts:75-87 — MEDIUM: the pure-fixture branch runs before status rejection and ignores changedFileStatus, so a declared fixture with status D/R/C is emitted as ELIGIBLE_PURE_STORY_FIXTURE. Reproduction against dist with changedFileStatus={tests/case.fixture.json:D} returned eligible=true. This contradicts the registry/verification intent that rename and deletion must fail closed; current rename smoke covers only a non-declared src path.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 5f7ec42a83: declared fixture delete, rename and copy statuses are rejected before eligibility, with D/R/C and parse-unavailable policy regressions passing.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/review-incremental-context.ts:387-429 — HIGH: the only trusted freshness classes accepted for incremental are CURRENT_MATERIAL and KNOWN_METADATA_ONLY_HEAD_DRIFT. A real pure Story fixture commit changes both materialHash and storyFilesHash, so checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit classifies it RELATED_STORY_MATERIAL_DRIFT before impact policy is combined. Therefore the documented v1 capability pure test fixture with explicit binding may be incremental is unreachable in the integrated eligibility path; current smoke only unit-tests classifyImpact and demonstrates incremental on same-material reruns, not a fixture delta from a prior signed pass.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 5f7ec42a83: RELATED_STORY_MATERIAL_DRIFT is allowed only through the independently proven pure-fixture case-closure path; integrated committed fixture delta selects incremental when safe and cheaper, all other related drift remains full.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/impact-classification-policy.ts:92-97 and packages/main/src/core/review-incremental-context.ts:222-230 — HIGH: pure-fixture eligibility only checks whether each changed declared test file has at least one checklist intentRef. It never parses the changed fixture cases or binds each added/changed case to a current Story-scoped intentRef. Therefore a file with one old bound intent plus a newly added unbound case is mechanically classified ELIGIBLE_PURE_STORY_FIXTURE, violating eligibility-supported-fixture-closure and review-basis-omission-fails-closed. The smoke at review-incremental-context-smoke.ts only tests file-level present/absent refs and cannot catch this bypass.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 5f7ec42a83: git case-diff closure parses each changed fixture case and requires an exact current Story-scoped positional intentRef; an unbound added case deterministically selects full in integration tests.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/review-run.ts:193-227 and packages/main/src/tasks/prompt-full-context-envelope-smoke.ts:190-197 — HIGH: reviewer-requested full escalation is only unit-tested by passing reviewerEscalationReason directly to the assembler. The production review_run_start path never accepts or supplies that field, and there is no follow-up escalation command that mints a new reason-bound full ReviewRun. A reviewer served incremental context therefore cannot exercise reviewer-basis-incomplete-escalates or reviewer-authoritative-read-and-escalate in the real CLI/gate chain.
findings.resolvedReason: Duplicate of F-002; production review_run_start escalation input, signed binding, replay verification and built-CLI integration were added in 5f7ec42a83.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/quorum-submit-smoke.ts:906-944 and 1007-1017 — HIGH coverage gap: the shared collector/quorum test mutates only reviewRound on an earlier full envelope, while the incremental branch merely asserts a valid incremental envelope is accepted. No test serves incremental when recomputation requires full, and no test tampers the new incremental-only policy/freshness/prior-pass/file/basis/task/selection fields then proves REVIEW, collectReviewerEvidenceState, receipt/host-verdict, and quorum all reject it. This does not substantiate incremental-envelope-tamper-chain-rejected or served-wrong-mode-proof-invalid despite evidence notes claiming those paths.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 5f7ec42a83: quorum smoke now exercises a 10-field incremental Envelope tamper matrix plus authoritative wrong-mode recomputation across REVIEW collector and quorum admission; quorum passes 41/41.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/review-incremental-context-smoke.ts:429-494 — HIGH coverage gap: the forced-full campaign covers only docs, one public-contract path, authority, command-policy, package.json, private TS, unknown binary, and rename. It never exercises classificationUnavailable/FULL_DYNAMIC_OR_PARSE_FAILURE, deletion/copy status, wrong-lane or stale trusted baselines, empty/no-signal storyFilesHash, Runtime/Role/render/dispatch/environment/policy drift, or caller override attempts, although eligibility-forced-full-contract-policy, eligibility-unknown-fails-closed, eligibility-raw-hash-forgery-rejected, and unsupported-paths-and-stale-evidence-full require those classes. The recorded evidence overstates the executable campaign.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 5f7ec42a83: production-consumed forced-full classifier matrix covers Runtime, Role, environment, assembler, dispatch, scope, task, freshness, D/R/C, parse unavailable, wrong lane/stale/empty bindings and caller overrides.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/review-incremental-context-smoke.ts:165-246 — HIGH coverage gap: the read-only proof invokes the core helper sequentially against a synthetic store and snapshots only story/findings/passes/runs/currentReviewRound. It does not invoke the registered CLI handler, run calls concurrently, or snapshot process-events, prompt envelopes, receipts, host verdicts, floor/quorum artifacts, filesystem bytes, phase transitions, or DONE outcome. Consequently incremental-context-readonly-gate-neutral and readonly-command-cannot-smuggle-evidence are not proven to their stated boundary, and the evidence note claiming repeated/concurrent command-level gate neutrality is unsupported.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 5f7ec42a83: read-only smoke runs 8 concurrent real built-CLI calls and proves byte-identical lifecycle, finding/pass/run, receipt/quorum, git status, phase and DONE artifacts before and after.

findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/role-prompt-modularization-and-budget-execution-plan.md:788-820 — The repaired audit section still describes selection as recorded by every v1 Prompt Envelope and shows budgetViolation:null plus escalationReason:null. In the implemented strict contract both fields are optional non-null values (budgetViolation is only incremental|full; escalationReason is a nonblank string), and assembleConditionalReviewPromptEnvelope omits them on SAFE_INCREMENTAL (packages/main/src/core/prompt-contracts.ts:228-229,639-640; packages/main/src/core/prompt-envelope.ts:427-435). Story-dispatch/legacy full envelopes also do not necessarily carry Story 4 selection fields. Narrow the opening sentence to Story-4 conditionally assembled review-run envelopes and omit the two keys from the SAFE_INCREMENTAL JSON example (or provide separate valid violation/escalation examples). This preserves the now-correct first-pass/legacy optional semantics instead of publishing an example the validator rejects.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in b06d3dcc56: audit prose now scopes Story 4 selection fields to conditionally assembled trusted review-run envelopes; optional non-null budgetViolation and escalationReason are omitted when absent, and legacy/story-dispatch/first-pass semantics are explicit.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/review-incremental-context.ts:262-264 — HIGH adversarial bypass remains in F-007 repair: fixtureCaseClosure constructs prior/current Maps from case keys but never rejects duplicate _id/id/name keys. An attacker can add an unbound duplicate case before the unchanged original case with the same key; Map construction overwrites the unbound entry with the later unchanged original, the digest comparison sees no change, and closure returns true. This violates the requirement that every added/changed fixture case carry a current Story-scoped intentRef. Reject duplicate keys or evaluate every case occurrence, and add a real fixture regression for duplicate-key ordering.
